Uneventful middle a few notes for guests
Please read this before you travel
Companion Animal Travel Desk notice

Travelers need to check companion animal papers before arriving at the airport, because missing details can slow the handoff and put the booking at risk. Aurelia Skyways records service changes in the desk ledger, and the team needs clear, complete information from every traveler.

If you are traveling with a small dog, please bring the crate, the carrier labels, and the needed forms in good order. <<FACT F068>> Staff also remind travelers to keep the animal calm, fed, and ready for screening, and to speak up early if anything on the booking has changed. <<FACT F074>>

Bird travelers need extra care, so please keep the health certificate with the rest of the travel papers and present it without delay. <<FACT F083>> Bring clean carriers, secure closures, and any comfort items that the crew has approved. The desk is here to help with same-day checks, but only if the papers are complete and readable.

Please go to the Companion Animal Travel Desk right away for review.
